dedupe_keys.name: calculation files for the master s thesis

description: Mihkel Pert deposited calculation outputs for a master's thesis on onshore power supply at Heltermaa Port. The TalTech repository describes seven PDF files containing results for scenarios A, B and C and a battery energy storage sensitivity analysis with 10, 20 and 30 MWh capacity cases. These are model calculation outputs for port electrification and storage capacity planning. They are not operational measurements of an installed system. The resource was published in May 2026; the simulated time horizon, timestep, input assumptions and internal table schema are not established by the public metadata. Repository file descriptors identify the scenario and sensitivity-analysis documents, totalling 36,969,897 bytes. The PDFs are publicly available without a stated charge under CC BY 4.0. Only repository metadata was inspected, so the numerical results and model validity have not been checked. Update frequency is not stated. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
